repos.name: Elyon-Public-Proof
repos.head: d88ad76
repos.title: Elyon Public Proof
repos.summary: Public, independently reviewable snapshot of the Elyon Claim1–Claim7 formal verification package. git clone https://github.com/ShantiDraconis/Elyon-Public-Proof cd Elyon-Public-Proof curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leanprover/elan/master/elan-init.sh | sh -s -- -y --default-toolchain none export PATH="$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH" elan toolchain install "$(cat lean-toolchain)" elan default "$(cat lean-toolchain)" lake update sha256sum -c certs/elyon_claim1_7_only/SHA256SUMS lake build MCore.Real.Claim1To7Only lake build
